tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: The brand color. Primary buttons, the script accent word, recipe-card top bands, allergen warnings. Text on it is always white (5.6:1), never navy. One cherry-filled element per content block.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Ink. All body and headline text on paper, white, parchment, mustard and mint; every 2px outline and hard shadow; selected chips and options; the focus ring.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. Unselected option buttons and chips.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: Highlight. Starbursts, the strong goal tag, selected-state accents, progress fills. Text on it is navy (7.5:1).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary accent. Illustration backdrops, filter tags (Kid-friendly), the vote panel. Text on it is navy (9:1); never navy-muted.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Image and video placeholders, amount highlights in steps, quiet panels. Text on it is navy or navy-muted.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards, recipe index cards, inputs and secondary buttons sitting on paper.

tokens.name: navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, captions, helper lines) on paper (5.4:1), white (6:1) and parchment (4.7:1). Never on mint or mustard.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy fills: selected chips, selected options, toasts.

tokens.name: on-cherry
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cherry fills: primary buttons, warnings.

tokens.name: rule-blue
tokens.usage: Ruled lines on recipe index cards only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero line per screen: welcome, weekly menu header.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The single question or headline on a mobile screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Recipe and card titles, section headings.

styles.name: script
styles.usage: One short cherry accent above a headline or inside a starburst. Two to three words, at most once per screen.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Beans and kale carry the fiber tonight.
styles.usage: Lead sentence under a headline; recipe steps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lemon helps you absorb the iron.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips, tags and badges (700 when selected).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines: creator credit, time, pantry match.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on recipe index cards and section tops.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chip rows and between stacked lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between option buttons and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Mobile screen padding; gap between content blocks on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks on desktop.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Recipe index cards and the creator embed frame.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Recipe cards, the fit card, image placeholders, panels and sheets' inner blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, option buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, goal badges and progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Hard offset drop under every button, down and to the right like a printed misregistration. On press it shrinks to 2px 2px and the button moves 2px down and right.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Hard drop under recipe cards, index cards and the fit card. No blurred shadows anywhere.

tokens.name: stroke-ink
tokens.usage: Navy outline on buttons, chips, cards, options, starbursts and illustrations.
